parameters.content:
## area:coo:plan — materialise
Fires when the **plan goal is ticked** (routine endEvent -> coo-end).

Reads the goal's **ticked subtasks** (`[<routine>] <title>`), re-derives each routine's week-goal `taskRef`/`goalRef`/tags, and creates the ticked ones as real **day tasks** tagged `area:coo:execute` + `plan:auto`.

Idempotent: skips routines already carrying a `plan:auto` task today.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ models: ['~google/gemini-flash-latest'], messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json.systemPrompt }, { role: 'user', content: $json.userMessage } ], temperature: 0.3, max_tokens: 2500, top_p: 0.9, reasoning: { enabled: false }, response_format: { type: 'json_object' } }) }}

parameters.content:
## area:coo:execute — daily wrap
Fires when the **office-work goal is ticked** (routine endEvent -> coo-end).

Collects everything **completed today** under the goal's own `taskRef` (finished tasks + finished subtasks, with their contribution notes) straight from the app — **no Jira calls**; ticket keys are read off the work itself.

Produces the three things that have to be filed: **5 SRE Confluence bullets**, **Tempo worklogs** (one row per ticket + one Scrum row) and the **Coforge timesheet** split across development / testing / operations / monitoring / management. Hours are normalised in code to total 8h in 0.25 steps — the model only proposes the shape.

The copy-paste HTML sheet is saved to the goal's **reward** (`updateGoalItemReward`) and returned as the webhook response. **body and contribution are never written by this branch.**

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ models: ['~google/gemini-flash-latest'], messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json.systemPrompt }, { role: 'user', content: $json.userMessage } ], temperature: 0.4, max_tokens: 3000, reasoning: { enabled: false }, response_format: { type: 'json_object' } }) }}

parameters.content:
## area:coo:check / :reflect — Reflect Dashboard
Fires from the **Night Routine** (22:30) endEvent -> coo-end.

Collect (code): weekStimuli D/K/G, routineDate in/out-of-time, dailyGoals by area, chess.com, xpBalance. LLM only judges: headline, 3 COO feedback scores, soul thought, 4 reflection MCQs.

Dashboard HTML -> goal **reward** + webhook response.
